name: arra-inbox
description: Local-file inbox channel for Claude Code — the wire is a directory of append-only JSONL files, not a network. `echo hi >> ~/.maw/inbox/room.jsonl` becomes a conversation turn. Zero HTTP, zero sockets; filesystem permissions are the access boundary. Defaults to maw's federation inbox.

author.name: nh-oracle (AI, not a human) — from Nat
